pr.body:
## Why
The manifest advertised UMM 0.28.2 while builds used whatever loader and Harmony DLLs happened to be installed. That did not establish the common 0.31.x baseline requested across the Kingmaker mods.

## Changes
- Set the common minimum to UMM **0.31.1**, matching Tabletop Rules Expansion and Cutscene Skip.
- Compile against SHA-256-verified upstream UMM 0.31.1, Harmony12 1.2.0.1 and Harmony 2.3.1.1 references kept outside the installed game; the exact compiler inputs are checked in direct MSBuild and in the build wrapper.
- `Build.ps1` records a receipt beside each ZIP (producing commit, build inputs including the exact compiler command line, pinned reference identities, ZIP and DLL digests) and places a ZIP only after the ZIP/receipt pair has been validated.
- `Validate-Package.ps1` checks any supplied ZIP before installation: allowed files, manifest, product assembly identity and exactly the pinned loader references. Two receipt modes:
  - `-ReceiptPath` alone: **byte matching only** - the receipt must describe these exact bytes (ZIP and DLL digests, version, minimum UMM, pinned references). It says nothing about whether the sources or build inputs are still current.
  - `-ReceiptPath` with `-RequireCurrentProvenance` (frozen candidates; also what `KwrRuntime.ps1` uses when a receipt is beside the ZIP): additionally a clean producing commit that exists in the repository, material inputs (including every tracked file the compiler inventory names, such as the embedded art) equal to that commit, no unidentified compiler input, and the recorded compiler command line and build-input fingerprint equal to what MSBuild resolves now.
- `KwrRuntime.ps1` installs only a validated private copy of the package and records how it was qualified: `frozen-candidate` (current provenance), `diagnostic` (`-Diagnostic`, receipt byte matching only) or `external-content-inspected` (no receipt).
- `docs/UMM-COMPATIBILITY.md` records the contract and evidence; each newer loader stays a separate compatibility target, and historical runtime evidence keeps its original identity.

## Validation
Windows host (Kingmaker 2.1.7b managed assemblies, Visual Studio Build Tools): `Build.ps1` with the pinned references (290/290 tests, embedded art verified, package and receipt validated); `scripts/Test-LoaderBaseline.ps1` boundary suite on a temporary clone (108/108 on the current tooling); the configured agent-review baseline gate; a static loader API audit of the candidate DLL against UMM 0.31.1, 0.32.4, the owner's 0.33.0 and 0.33.4. Structured records are in `docs/evidence/umm-0311/`.

**Not run:** in-game compatibility on any loader version. The runtime harness transacts against the live game, and no disposable game copy is available; this draft makes no runtime-support claim.

No gameplay code, save format, installed game, published package or release was changed.
pr.title: build: establish the UMM 0.31.1 baseline
